company.name: Botanika
company.shortDescription: Botanika is a pioneering company specializing in hyper-scalable, decentralized data storage solutions
company.description: Botanika is developing an efficient, hyper-scalable, decentralized data storage network powered by its proprietary B1 hardware nodes. Utilizing patented AI-driven sharding, transmission, and data regeneration algorithms, Botanika aims to revolutionize the decentralized storage landscape. The company's mission is to offer a cost-effective, secure, and scalable data storage solution for both individuals and institutions in today's digital age
